timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹179.42 Cr, net profit ₹12.75 Cr.
Mangal Electrical reported FY26 standalone revenue of ₹579.7 Cr and net profit of ₹43.2 Cr.
Mangal Electrical released its FY26 investor presentation reporting revenue of ₹579.7 Cr and net profit of ₹43.2 Cr.
Mangal Electrical reported Q4FY26 standalone revenue of ₹179.42 Cr and net profit of ₹12.75 Cr, and approved an ESOP scheme.
On June 4, 2026, Mangal Electrical Industries announced the resignation of CFO Pawan Mendiratta, effective September 3, 2026.
Mangal Electrical Industries filed its Monitoring Agency Report for Q2FY27 showing ₹77.50 Cr of unutilised IPO proceeds.
